bugsAndLimitations.severity: high for metrics, low for actions
bugsAndLimitations.what: The 'nothing here' hypothesis (B4) fires on real roads whose endpoint vertex carries a knight badge (or a metropolis tower): the badge covers the end of the full-length road template, the error rises to 40-75 and the colour margin collapses below 12. 454 of the 471 unreadable roads with a seated colour and no overlay are knight-adjacent (96%; baseline 58% of all roads); 35 of 36 sampled were real roads with A's colour. v2 had the colour right on 491 of the 719.
bugsAndLimitations.impact: colour agreement 65,562 -> 65,071 (-491) is B's loss, not A's error; kind agreement 98.86% likewise. No action is built on these (drop needs phantom-colour), so the actions are unaffected, but 'unreadable' must not be read as 'A hallucinated a road'. 16 of the 227 phantom+unreadable drops are knight-adjacent; 7 of them have no overlay and 2 are unclear by eye.
bugsAndLimitations.fix: score roads on the middle ~60% of the edge (drop samples within KNIGHT_DIAMETER/2 of either vertex when a knight or tower is detected there), or only call 'none' when best > roadNone and margin < roadNoneMargin AND no endpoint carries a knight/metropolis.

bugsAndLimitations.what: 40 buys precision (6/6 tiles at 40-50 covered) at a large recall cost: 10 of 12 sampled tiles in the 30-40 band are covered by banners, trade panels or cards, and 3 of 6 in 25-30. The v2 audit's two false hits (31.9, 32.7) are real but the band is mostly true covers.
bugsAndLimitations.impact: capture level: small, 40 of the 43 tiles in 30-40 sit in captures already flagged by tokensFound<18. Piece level: the ~35 covered tiles in 30-40 give no under-overlay flag to the pieces on them.
bugsAndLimitations.fix: 30 as the threshold with the knight-clip exception (a knight badge at a vertex of the tile explains a 30-35 score), or keep 40 and add 'token in a tokensFound<18 capture scoring > 30'.

bugsAndLimitations.what: The building+road path seats a colour from A's own labels alone; two hallucinated pieces of one colour (a 'white road' under an undetected panel plus a 'white settlement' under a card) would seat that colour and exempt every later white phantom from drop. The under-overlay exclusion is only as good as findOverlays. The strong-b path is safe (needs A==B, score<20, x3).
bugsAndLimitations.impact: none observed: 15/15 colours seated by building+road only are real; 13/13 colours of 5 random newly inferred games are real; no game has more than 4 seats except white7201 (5, registry). Also the cause of the one remaining complete-seats: fort4077 v41 is excluded because tile 15's token is hidden by a real '+2' banner.
bugsAndLimitations.fix: require the building+road pair to come from pieces B does not call 'none' and scoring < weak, or require two captures for building+road-only seats when the game has >= 2 frames.

bugsAndLimitations.what: tokensFound<18 alone flags 26 captures; 9/12 viewed have real UI (cards, small banners), 3 are render anomalies (a token missing or displaced: fort9510/03, 256548064/01, king5484/11) or the robber. Those boards are not cleanly readable either, so the flag is defensible, but they are not 'UI panels'.
bugsAndLimitations.impact: mark-capture-overlay-contaminated precision about 20/24 by eye; the 4 misses are unreadable boards anyway.

bugsAndLimitations.what: --list/--debug runs infer seats from the listed subset of a game only; a partial rerun of one capture is not comparable with the full run (the full run is fine).

'colour agreement over pieces B has an answer for' (99.92%) removes B's own failures from the denominator, so it flatters B; 'kind agreement' 98.86% counts the 719 'none' as kind disagreements although (F1) most are B's.
bugsAndLimitations.impact: numbers are computed correctly; the interpretation in report.md is one-sided.

bugsAndLimitations.what: The robber (3 tiles) and merchant (1) hide a token and count as covers -> under-overlay for their pieces.
v2 action counts are hard-coded rather than read from classification-v2/report.json.
